title: The Second Memorial; Chencang Will Not Fall
summary: Zhuge Liang goes north again, and the whole expedition breaks on one small fortress. Chencang is held by a single stubborn officer with a thousand men who has prepared for exactly this, and every method Shu tries — ladders, towers, tunnels, fire — is answered within the hour.
Twenty days later the grain runs out and the army goes home. It is the pattern of every remaining campaign: Shu can beat any Wei army in the field and cannot feed itself long enough to matter.
history: Historical. The logistics are the real story of the northern expeditions, and the novel is honest about it even while celebrating the stratagems.

pins.note: Broken by one fortress and a supply line.
